test_title: PYST 41: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Two taps, X and Y, can fill a tank in 12 hours and 24 hours, respectively. If both the taps are open, then due to leakage, it takes 30 minutes more to fill the tank. If the tank is full, how long will it take for the leakage alone to empty the tank?
solution:
**Given:**

Tap X = 12 hours

Tap Y = 24 hours

With leakage, time = 30 minutes more

**Formula used:**

Rate = 1/time, net rate = sum(fill rates) − leak rate, leak time = 1 / leak rate

**Calculations:**

⇒ fill rate X = dfrac{1}{12}, Y = dfrac{1}{24}

⇒ combined no-leak rate = dfrac{1}{12}+dfrac{1}{24}=dfrac{1}{8} ⇒ time = 8 hours

⇒ Actual time = 8 + 0.5 = 8.5 hours = dfrac{17}{2} hours ⇒ actual net rate = dfrac{1}{8.5}=dfrac{2}{17}

⇒ Leak rate = dfrac{1}{8}-dfrac{2}{17}=dfrac{17-16}{136}=dfrac{1}{136}

⇒ Leak alone empties tank in 136 hours

**∴ Time = 136 hours**
